acceptance: Independent publication merged forward into an unfinished descendant preserves its authenticated lifecycle origin, series identity, original request clock, unresolved finding IDs and retained observations. Publication scope advances independently to the current native baseline.

Refreshed approved proposals preserve the unfinished lineage. Actual repairs resolve the existing finding IDs through current input-bound evidence, and new defects retain normal finding classification and allocation.

Coverage reuse requires unchanged applicable source bytes, modes, dependencies, criteria, configuration, authority and environment. Changed evidence or consumed inputs produces explicit invalidation without losing original records or granting approval.

Lifecycle completion requires immutable successful native assessment history bound to the actual candidate tree and proof that its corresponding candidate was published. Origin ancestry, independent publication, proposal approval and ERROR, INCOMPLETE or REJECTED assessments alone cannot establish completion. Missing or tampered custody fails closed.

Synthetic branch scenarios exercise independent publication, proposal refresh, real finding resolution, unchanged reuse, changed-input invalidation and genuine lifecycle completion. Existing declared test discovery, deadlines, concurrency and assertions remain intact, with unchanged-test assertion failure before the implementation and complete success afterward.

Current candidate verification, source-frontier accounting, immutable history, exact publication scope and deterministic source admission retain their existing boundaries. Historical records remain byte-identical, prior approval never becomes current approval, and no model or paid service is launched by synthetic regressions.

Native deterministic verification includes exactly one genuine bounded existing-CLI conceptual proposal witness with immutable source, runtime and output custody. Public CI removes only the native-only live-proposal module and completely executes the remaining nonempty selected projection without provider calls; all existing profile obligations remain required.

Lifecycle completion accepts distinct native source, package and actual-Oracle proof kinds only with authentic approved task/spec binding, exact original candidate and immutable producer custody, no unresolved findings, and actual corresponding source publication ancestry. Source/package positives use their real native producers with synthetic fixed checks; actual-Oracle consumption verifies original scope, selected commands, export, genuine CLI witness and outputs through its existing native profile. Unrelated publications, artifact-only or CI-only evidence, missing, tampered or stale custody and a second unfinished task cannot establish completion. Completion observations preserve original marker, series, clocks, finding IDs and proof identities; VERIFIED remains distinct from APPROVED.

acceptance_tests.purpose: Exercise lineage continuity and completion through synthetic native review-series scenarios, including finding resolution, evidence applicability and preserved custody.
Verify controller lifecycle, continuation, process ownership and failure handling remain intact.
Verify current publication-range source accounting and fail-closed source-frontier admission remain intact.
Verify the genuine bounded native CLI conceptual proposal witness and its source, runtime, process and result bindings.
Provide complete offline proposal-core and custody checks in the nonempty public CI acceptance projection.

selection.reason: Review lineage affects finding retention, evidence reuse and publication-range accounting. Preserve the prior reproduction, lifecycle and source-frontier interactions and add the existing deterministic profile's native proposal witness with a nonempty offline acceptance projection. Preserve unchanged test bytes, original delivery clock, immutable evidence and every existing profile obligation.
